attribution_note: poc_queue/deep_pass tagged all three items with finding_refs [EA-001, EA-002]. VERIFIED WRONG: EA-001 and EA-002 are Flood/Season-of-Plenty Bean mint-and-dump findings located in LibFlood.sol (sopWell / floodPodline mint sizing + front-run). The LibGauge sunrise-DoS family is a gauge-arithmetic revert (div-by-zero / SafeCast overflow / checked-sub underflow) inside stepGauge, an entirely distinct mechanism with no overlap to the SOP mint path. EA-001/EA-002 attribution is removed. Items 1 and 3 are NEW (not duplicate_or_known). Item 2 IS a genuine duplicate of AR-001.

verdicts.title: updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason div-by-zero on totalGaugePoints==0 reverts stepGauge inline in sunrise (permissionless season-advance DoS)
verdicts.attacker_entrypoint: SeasonFacet.sunrise() / gm() (external payable, permissionless once seasonTime() > current season; only requires !paused) -> LibGauge.stepGauge() -> updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason() -> line 272 newGrownStalk.mul(GP_PRECISION).div(totalGaugePoints).
verdicts.preconditions: totalGaugePoints == 0 at line 272. Early-return guard at line 244 checks ONLY totalGaugeBdv==0, NOT totalGaugePoints. totalGaugePoints is the sum of every whitelisted LP token's newGaugePoints (multi-LP path) or the single pool's stored gaugePoints (single-LP path), plus the bean term beanGpPerBdv*beanDepositedBdv/1e6. defaultGaugePointFunction (GaugePointFacet.sol line 53) explicitly returns 0 when currentGaugePoints<=ONE_POINT (1e18) and the pool is over its optimal-BDV threshold, so an LP token's gaugePoints CAN be ground to 0 across seasons via sustained over-threshold deposits. When all LP gaugePoints reach 0: maxLpGpPerBdv->0 => beanGpPerBdv->0 => bean term->0 => totalGaugePoints->0 => div-by-zero revert (LibRedundantMath256.div = native a/b, reverts on zero divisor under 0.8.20). Note: in the single-LP branch (lines 103-128) calcGaugePoints is NOT called, so the single pool's stored gaugePoints is read as-is and would need to already be 0; the multi-LP grind path is the realistic trigger. Reachability of the all-zero gauge-points runtime state across seasons must be proven on a fork.
verdicts.state_before: s.sys.season.current = N (> targetSeasonsToCatchUp); sunrise callable; gauge state where every whitelisted LP token's gaugePoints has decayed to 0 (or single-LP stored gaugePoints==0) and the bean gauge term is 0; totalGaugeBdv > 0 (so the line 244 guard does NOT early-return).
verdicts.state_after: Line 272 division reverts; the revert propagates out of stepGauge through gm()/sunrise(); season does NOT advance; sunrise is bricked for as long as totalGaugePoints stays 0 (and gauge points are only mutated inside the same reverting stepGauge call, raising a potential permanent-brick concern to verify on fork).
verdicts.impact_hypothesis: Permissionless, no-privilege denial of service of the protocol heartbeat (season advancement). Halts all sunrise-gated mechanics: Bean mint/burn, soil issuance, stalk grown-stalk issuance, germination finalization, flood. Severity gated by whether the all-zero gauge-points state is (a) reachable and (b) self-recoverable; if it is reachable and not self-recoverable it is a hard freeze.
verdicts.min_poc_plan: Foundry fork/mock of the Beanstalk diamond. (L1 Entry) From an unprivileged EOA: across seasons, deposit LP into a whitelisted pool above its optimalPercentDepositedBdv threshold to drive defaultGaugePointFunction to step the pool's gaugePoints down by 1e18/season to 0; if multi-LP, repeat for every whitelisted LP token. Set bean term to 0 (maxLpGpPerBdv==0 once all LP gpPerBdv==0). (L2 State Flip) vm.load / read s.sys.silo.assetSettings[token].gaugePoints == 0 for all LP tokens immediately before the target sunrise; assert computed totalGaugePoints == 0. (L3 Outcome) vm.warp past seasonTime; call sunrise(); assert it reverts with a division-by-zero (panic 0x12) originating at LibGauge.sol:272; assert s.sys.season.current is unchanged; demonstrate a non-zero-gauge-points control sunrise succeeds. Document whether any non-sunrise path can restore non-zero gauge points (recoverability).
verdicts.duplicate_check: NOT a duplicate. Distinct from EA-001/EA-002 (LibFlood SOP mint-and-dump) - different file, different mechanism. Distinct from AR-001 (getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv .sub underflow at line 351). This is the line-272 division-by-zero on totalGaugePoints, a separate unguarded arithmetic site. NEW finding.
verdicts.reasoning_summary: Independently re-derived from source: the line 244 early-return only guards totalGaugeBdv, leaving line 272's division by totalGaugePoints unprotected. GaugePointFacet.defaultGaugePointFunction line 53 proves gauge points are drivable to 0, and the value feeds totalGaugePoints with no floor. The whole computation is inline in the permissionless sunrise path, so the revert is a season-advance DoS. The only open question is the multi-season runtime reachability of an all-zero gauge-points state, which is exactly what a fork PoC must establish - hence needs_fork_poc, not auto-confirm and not false_positive.

verdicts.title: issueGrownStalkPerBdv uint32 SafeCast overflow reverts stepGauge inline in sunrise (permissionless season-advance DoS)
verdicts.attacker_entrypoint: SeasonFacet.sunrise() / gm() (permissionless) -> LibGauge.stepGauge() -> updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason() -> issueGrownStalkPerBdv() -> line 305 grownStalkPerGp.mul(gpPerBdv).div(GP_PRECISION).toUint32().
verdicts.preconditions: Per-token stalkPerBdvPerSeason = grownStalkPerGp * gpPerBdv / GP_PRECISION exceeds type(uint32).max (~4.294e9). grownStalkPerGp = newGrownStalk * 1e18 / totalGaugePoints; newGrownStalk = averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason * totalGaugeBdv / BDV_PRECISION. No local clamp bounds the result below uint32 before SafeCast.toUint32 (which REVERTS, not truncates, on overflow). Requires a runtime state where averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason and/or gauge-point concentration (gpPerBdv) push the cast operand above 2^32-1. Whether realistic stalk/BDV magnitudes and attainable gauge concentration can reach this must be proven on a fork (not enforced locally).
verdicts.state_before: s.sys.season.current = N (> targetSeasonsToCatchUp so averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason has been updated); sunrise callable; gauge state with high averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason and/or a token with skewed gpPerBdv such that grownStalkPerGp*gpPerBdv/1e18 > type(uint32).max.
verdicts.state_after: SafeCast.toUint32 reverts; revert propagates through stepGauge -> gm()/sunrise(); season does NOT advance; sunrise blocked while the overflowing state persists.
verdicts.impact_hypothesis: Permissionless DoS of season advancement and all sunrise-gated mechanics. Conditional on a reachable economic/gauge state that overflows uint32; if attainable by an attacker via large deposits / extreme gauge concentration, it is an attacker-triggerable freeze; if only reachable through organic long-run growth it is a latent protocol-halt risk.
verdicts.min_poc_plan: Foundry fork/mock. (L1 Entry) From an unprivileged EOA, drive the silo into a state with large averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason and/or concentrate gpPerBdv for one token (large deposits into one pool, advance seasons). (L2 State Flip) Read/compute grownStalkPerGp and gpPerBdv just before the target sunrise; assert grownStalkPerGp*gpPerBdv/GP_PRECISION > type(uint32).max. (L3 Outcome) vm.warp past seasonTime; call sunrise(); assert revert from SafeCast.toUint32 (SafeCastOverflowedUintDowncast / panic) at LibGauge.sol:305; assert s.sys.season.current unchanged; show a controlled smaller-state sunrise succeeds. Establish whether the overflowing state is attacker-attainable vs only organically reachable.
verdicts.duplicate_check: NOT a duplicate. Distinct from EA-001/EA-002 (LibFlood SOP). Distinct from AR-001 (line 351 .sub underflow) and from the updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason line-272 div-by-zero - this is the uint32 downcast overflow at line 305, a separate unguarded arithmetic site. NEW finding.
verdicts.reasoning_summary: Independently re-derived: line 305 casts an unbounded per-season stalk-per-BDV product to uint32 via SafeCast (reverting downcast) with no upstream floor/clamp in this library. The operand is a function of averageGrownStalkPerBdvPerSeason, totalGaugeBdv, and gauge-point share, none locally bounded under 2^32. Inline in permissionless sunrise => revert = season DoS. The open question is whether a reachable runtime state overflows uint32 (and whether an attacker can force it), which a fork PoC must resolve - hence needs_fork_poc.

verdicts.title: updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason checked-sub underflow (stalk/totalBdv < STALK_BDV_PRECISION) reverts stepGauge in sunrise
verdicts.attacker_entrypoint: SeasonFacet.sunrise() / gm() -> LibGauge.stepGauge() -> updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason() -> updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason() -> getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv() line 351 s.sys.silo.stalk.div(totalBdv).sub(STALK_BDV_PRECISION).
verdicts.duplicate_check: GENUINE DUPLICATE of AR-001. AR-001 (title: 'getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv underflows when total stalk-per-BDV falls below STALK_BDV_PRECISION, reverting stepGauge and bricking season advancement', file LibGauge.sol, severity Medium, status submit) names the identical revert site (line 351 checked .sub(1e4)), the identical reachability path (sunrise/gm -> stepGauge -> getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv), the identical precondition (stalk/totalBdv < 1e4, reachable post-reseed/migration via the LG-001/PC-001 desync), and the identical impact (temporary season-freeze DoS, Medium per Immunefi v2.2). updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason (line 320-324) is merely the immediate caller of getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv; the underflow physically occurs inside getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv, which AR-001 already pins. The plain uint128() truncation in updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason (line 320, not SafeCast) is a separate theoretical concern but is gated behind the same function and is documented as 'highly improbable'; it does not constitute a distinct confirmed bug and is subsumed. No new PoC warranted; AR-001's PoC/triage covers it. NOT related to EA-001/EA-002.
verdicts.reasoning_summary: Re-derived from source: the only reverting arithmetic reachable through updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason is getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv's line-351 checked subtraction, which is exactly AR-001's confirmed finding (same site, same path, same precondition, same Medium DoS impact). Marking duplicate_of AR-001 rather than re-confirming avoids double-counting. The EA-001/EA-002 attribution on this item was incorrect and is rejected.
